title: Exact Scaling Laws for a Random-Features Bigram Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.19281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding neural scaling laws is increasingly important for theory and practice, yet first-principles explanations remain limited even in simple settings. In this work, we study capacity-limited scaling in a bottlenecked bigram model with power-law (Zipf) token statistics, viewed as an analytically tractable toy model of a large language model. Fixed random embeddings serve as a proxy for representational capacity and induce an explicit bottleneck of width, allowing us to derive scaling laws for prediction regret as a function of model width, vocabulary size, and the Zipf exponent. Our results complement recent theoretical accounts based on optimization dynamics by isolating scaling due purely to representational constraints. In the appropriate regime, the theory recovers the functional form of classical neural scaling laws and suggests that heavy-tailed language statistics may underlie both optimization- and capacity-driven scaling.

translated_title: 随机特征二元模型的精确缩放定律
translated_abstract: 理解神经缩放定律对理论和实践都越来越重要，然而即使在简单的设置下，基于第一性原理的解释仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们研究了具有幂律（Zipf）词元统计的瓶颈二元模型中的容量受限缩放，将其视为大型语言模型的一个解析可处理的玩具模型。固定的随机嵌入作为表征容量的代理，并诱导出一个显式的宽度瓶颈，使我们能够推导出预测遗憾作为模型宽度、词表大小和Zipf指数的函数的缩放定律。我们的结果通过分离出纯粹由表征约束引起的缩放，补充了近期基于优化动力学的理论解释。在适当的范围内，该理论恢复了经典神经缩放定律的函数形式，并表明重尾语言统计可能是优化驱动和容量驱动缩放的共同底层原因。
tldr: 本文在具有Zipf词元统计的瓶颈随机特征二元模型中精确推导出预测遗憾随模型宽度、词表大小和Zipf指数变化的缩放定律，证明纯粹由表征容量约束即可产生经典神经缩放定律的函数形式。
en_tdlr: This paper derives exact scaling laws for prediction regret as a function of model width, vocabulary size, and the Zipf exponent in a bottlenecked random-features bigram model, showing that purely representational capacity constraints can reproduce the functional form of classical neural scaling laws.
